human_query: List active products priced over 100 dollars.
expected_sql: SELECT id, sku, name, base_price FROM products WHERE status = 'active' AND base_price > 100 ORDER BY base_price DESC;

human_query: Show the ten newest customers.
expected_sql: SELECT id, email, first_name, last_name, created_at FROM customers ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10;

human_query: Which distinct cities do we ship to?
expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT city FROM addresses WHERE address_type = 'shipping' ORDER BY city;

human_query: Find customers whose email contains example.com.
expected_sql: SELECT id, email FROM customers WHERE email LIKE '%example.com%';

human_query: Count orders by status.
expected_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC;

human_query: Calculate total revenue by month.
expected_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ordered_at, '%Y-%m') AS order_month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ordered_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY order_month;

human_query: Show customers and their lifetime order revenue.
expected_sql: SELECT c.id, c.email, SUM(o.total_amount) AS lifetime_revenue FROM customers c INNER JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.email ORDER BY lifetime_revenue DESC;

human_query: Show all customers even if they have never ordered.
expected_sql: SELECT c.id, c.email, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.email ORDER BY c.id;

human_query: Find employees with their managers.
expected_sql: SELECT e.email AS employee_email, m.email AS manager_email FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.id ORDER BY e.id;

human_query: List products with their categories.
expected_sql: SELECT p.sku, p.name, c.name AS category_name FROM products p INNER JOIN product_categories pc ON pc.product_id = p.id INNER JOIN categories c ON c.id = pc.category_id ORDER BY p.sku, c.name;

human_query: Which customers spent more than 500 total?
expected_sql: SELECT c.id, c.email, SUM(o.total_amount) AS spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.email HAVING SUM(o.total_amount) > 500 ORDER BY spend DESC;

human_query: Find products priced above the average product price.
expected_sql: SELECT id, sku, name, base_price FROM products WHERE base_price > (SELECT AVG(base_price) FROM products) ORDER BY base_price DESC;

human_query: List customers who placed at least one delivered order.
expected_sql: SELECT c.id, c.email FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'delivered') ORDER BY c.id;

human_query: List products that have never been ordered.
expected_sql: SELECT p.id, p.sku, p.name FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id = p.id) ORDER BY p.id;

human_query: Show paid orders from customers in the VIP segment.
expected_sql: SELECT id, order_number, total_amount FROM orders WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM customers c JOIN customer_segments s ON s.id = c.segment_id WHERE s.name = 'Customer Segments 1') ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

human_query: Rank products by revenue.
expected_sql: SELECT p.sku, p.name, SUM(oi.line_total) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.line_total) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.sku, p.name ORDER BY revenue_rank;

human_query: Number orders per customer from newest to oldest.
expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, order_number, ordered_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY ordered_at DESC) AS order_number_for_customer FROM orders ORDER BY customer_id, order_number_for_customer;

human_query: Show running revenue by order date.
expected_sql: SELECT ordered_at, order_number, total_amount, SUM(total_amount) OVER (ORDER BY ordered_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_revenue FROM orders ORDER BY ordered_at;

human_query: Compare each order to the previous order amount.
expected_sql: SELECT order_number, ordered_at, total_amount, LAG(total_amount) OVER (ORDER BY ordered_at) AS previous_total FROM orders ORDER BY ordered_at;

human_query: Show products matching the word seed in name or description.

human_query: Use IFNULL to show customers with no segment as Unassigned.

human_query: Find addresses with no second line.

human_query: Which product has the highest sales in each month?
